Say why the change exists. The diff already says what it does.

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] A bug is reproduced by a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] A record shape, protocol method, config key or hook payload change edits
      `docs/specs/rudy-contracts.md` in the same commit
- [ ] A decision worth remembering is an ADR under `docs/adr/`, appended never rewritten
